headline: 2026 MLB postseason field set as Wild Card Series begins with four matchups

supports: The 2026 MLB Wild Card Series begins Tuesday, September 29, 2026, with four best-of-three matchups: Red Sox at Yankees, White Sox at Astros, Cubs at Padres, and Phillies at Braves.

The 2026 division champions are the Tampa Bay Rays (AL East), Cleveland Guardians (AL Central) and Houston Astros (AL West), and the Milwaukee Brewers (NL Central), Los Angeles Dodgers (NL West) and Atlanta Braves (NL East), with the Yankees, Red Sox and White Sox as AL wild cards and the Padres, Cubs and Phillies as NL wild cards.

🇺🇸 Major League Baseball's 2026 postseason field is complete, and the Wild Card Series opens Tuesday, Sept. 29. Division champions Tampa Bay, Cleveland and Houston lead the American League, with Milwaukee, the Los Angeles Dodgers and Atlanta topping the National League. Four best-of-three series get underway: Red Sox at Yankees, White Sox at Astros, Cubs at Padres, and Phillies at Braves.

🇪🇸 El cuadro de playoffs 2026 de las Grandes Ligas quedó completo, y la Serie de Comodín arranca el martes 29 de septiembre.
